# Table 1
```{r}
# Helper function: generate summary table with Total column
make_summary_table1 <- function(data, var, rename_var = NULL, output_cols = c("Overall","by exp"),  exp_class_order = c("precipitation", "temperature", "flood","drought","Overall")
) {
  if(c("by exp") %in% output_cols){
    tmp_exp <- data %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
      distinct(studykey, exp_class, .data[[var]]) %>%
      count(.data[[var]], exp_class) 
  } else {
    tmp_exp <- data.frame()
  }
  
  if(c("Overall") %in% output_cols){
    tmp_total <- data %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
      distinct(studykey, .data[[var]]) %>%
      count(.data[[var]]) %>%
      mutate(exp_class="Overall")    
  } else {
    tmp_total <- data.frame()
  }
  
  if(!nrow(tmp_exp) == 0 & !nrow(tmp_total) == 0){
    tmp <- tmp_exp %>%
      bind_rows(tmp_total)
  } else if(nrow(tmp_exp) == 0){
    tmp <- tmp_total
  } else {
    tmp <- tmp_exp
  }
  
  tmp_long <- tmp %>% 
    rename(!!rename_var := .data[[var]])
  
  if (!is.null(exp_class_order)) {
    tmp_long <- tmp_long %>%
      mutate(exp_class = factor(exp_class, levels = exp_class_order))
  }

  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = tmp_long, weights = ~n)
  
  summary_tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,
    by = exp_class,
    includ = Category,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no"
  )
  
  summary_tbl <- as_tibble(summary_tbl)
  
  # Round the percentage
  summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>% 
    mutate(across(contains("%"), ~ceiling(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", .))), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

  return(as_gtsummary(summary_tbl))
}
```

## Table 1. Spatial-temporal characteristics
### Table 1. Study region
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data, "continent", "Category")
```

### Table 1. Study country
```{r}
get_country_count <- function(data, ctn = "other", ctn_col = "continent") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(survey)
  library(gtsummary)

  # Clean input and split country codes
  clean_data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(ctn_col, "eff_country")), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    separate_rows(eff_country, sep = "\\|") %>%
    distinct(studykey, !!sym(ctn_col), eff_country)

  # Filter for the selected continent
  continent_data <- clean_data %>%
    filter(!!sym(ctn_col) == tolower(ctn))

  # Count unique studies per individual country
  summary_data <- continent_data %>%
    group_by(eff_country) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(continent = ctn) %>%
    relocate(continent)

  # Total number of unique studies in the continent
  total_n <- continent_data %>%
    pull(studykey) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()

  # Create survey design
  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = summary_data, weights = ~n)

  # Generate table
  tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,
    by = "continent",
    include = "eff_country",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
    modify_caption(glue::glue("**Summary Table for Continent (overall): {str_to_title(ctn)}**"))

  # Add overall row
  overall_row <- tibble(
    variable = "eff_country",
    group = NA,
    label = "Overall",
    stat_1 = as.character(total_n)
  )

  final_tbl <- tbl %>%
    modify_table_body(
      ~ bind_rows(.x, overall_row)
    )

  return(final_tbl)
}

get_country_count_by_exp <- function(data, ctn = "other", ctn_col = "continent") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(survey)
  library(gtsummary)
  
  clean_data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(ctn_col, "eff_country", "exp_class")), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    separate_rows(eff_country, sep = "\\|") %>%
    distinct(studykey, !!sym(ctn_col), eff_country, exp_class)
  
  continent_data <- clean_data %>%
    filter(!!sym(ctn_col) == tolower(ctn))
  
  summary_data <- continent_data %>%
    group_by(eff_country, exp_class) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop")
  
  total_n <- continent_data %>%
    group_by(exp_class) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(exp_class)
  
  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = summary_data, weights = ~n)
  
  tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,
    by = "exp_class",
    include = "eff_country",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no",
    percent = "column"
  ) %>%
    modify_caption(glue::glue("**Summary Table of Country Counts by Exposure Class in {str_to_title(ctn)}**"))
  
  n_cols <- length(unique(summary_data$exp_class))
  stat_cols <- paste0("stat_", seq_len(n_cols))
  
  overall_row <- tibble(
    variable = "eff_country",
    label = "Overall",
    group = NA
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(setNames(as.list(as.character(total_n$n)), stat_cols))
  final_tbl <- tbl %>%
    modify_table_body(~ bind_rows(.x, overall_row))
  return(final_tbl)
}

```

```{r}
get_country_count(data = data,ctn = "other")
```

```{r}
get_country_count_by_exp(data = data,ctn = "other")
```

### Table 1. % of years with WHO reported cases 
```{r}
who_data<-read.csv(here::here(params$who_data_path)) %>%
  tidyr::separate(obs,c('time_left','time_right','suspected_cases','deaths','location_id','primary'),sep = ';',remove=T) %>%
  filter(primary == 't') %>% 
  merge(.,read.csv(here::here(params$location_file_path)),by.x="location_id",by.y="id",all.x=TRUE) %>%
  filter(is.na(region)==F) %>%
  arrange(region) %>%
  mutate(country = as.factor(region),suspected_cases=as.numeric(suspected_cases)) %>% 
  filter(time_right >= as.Date("2000-01-01") & time_right <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(time_right)) %>% 
  select(country,suspected_cases,year)

summary_tbl <- identify_endemicity(
  processed_data = data %>% filter(continent == "Other"),
  who_data = who_data,
  group_col = 'exp_class'
) %>%
  mutate(endemicity_group = case_when(
    percent_year_with_cases <= 50 ~ "0-50%",
    percent_year_with_cases > 50 & percent_year_with_cases <= 95 ~ "50-95%",
    percent_year_with_cases > 95 ~ ">95%"
  )) %>%
  group_by(endemicity_group, exp_class) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(country), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(exp_class) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
         formatted = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(endemicity_group, exp_class, formatted) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_class, values_from = formatted, values_fill = "0 (0%)") 

summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Population by Endemicity Group and Exposure Type")
```
```{r}
summary_tbl <- identify_endemicity(
  processed_data = data %>% filter(continent == "Other"),
  who_data = who_data,
  group_col = NULL
) %>%
  mutate(endemicity_group = case_when(
    percent_year_with_cases <= 50 ~ "0-50%",
    percent_year_with_cases > 50 & percent_year_with_cases <= 95 ~ "50-95%",
    percent_year_with_cases > 95 ~ ">95%"
  )) %>%
  group_by(endemicity_group) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(country), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
         formatted = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(group = "overall") %>% 
  select(endemicity_group,group, formatted) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = formatted, values_fill = "0 (0%)") 

summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Population by Endemicity Group Type")
```

### Table 1. Any reported uncertainty
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data %>% filter(continent == "Other") %>% 
                      group_by(studykey,exp_class) %>% 
                      summarize(study_report_sig = case_when(
                        any(sig_report) ~ "TRUE",
                        TRUE ~ "FALSE"
                      )) %>% 
                      ungroup(), "study_report_sig", "Category",output_cols = "by exp",exp_class_order = c("precipitation", "temperature", "flood","drought"))

data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(continent == "Other") %>%
  group_by(studykey) %>%
  summarize(study_report_sig = case_when(
    any(sig_report) ~ "TRUE",
    TRUE ~ "FALSE"
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

if (n_distinct(data_filtered$study_report_sig) == 1) {
  fake_row <- data_filtered[1, ]
  fake_row$study_report_sig <- as.character("FALSE")
  fake_row$studykey <- "dummy_study"
  data_filtered <- bind_rows(data_filtered, fake_row)
}

make_summary_table1(
  data = data_filtered,
  var = "study_report_sig",
  rename_var = "Category",
  output_cols = "Overall",
  exp_class_order = c("Overall")
)
```

## Table 1. Study quality
```{r}
# Study Quality
data <- data  %>% filter(continent == "Other") %>% 
  get_study_scores()

study_avg_score <- data %>%
  group_by(studykey,exp_class) %>%
  summarize(min_tot_score_est = mean(min_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_exp_tot_score_est = mean(min_exp_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_out_tot_score_est = mean(min_out_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_a_tot_score_est = mean(min_a_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    min_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_tot_score_est == 11 ~ "11",
      min_tot_score_est <= 5 ~ "≤ 5",
      min_tot_score_est > 5 & min_tot_score_est < 11 ~ "6-10"
    ),
    min_out_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_out_tot_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
    min_exp_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_exp_tot_score_est == 3 ~ "3",
      TRUE ~ "<3"
    ),
    min_a_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_a_tot_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
  )

study_avg_score_total <- data %>%
  group_by(studykey) %>%
  summarize(min_tot_score_est = mean(min_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_exp_tot_score_est = mean(min_exp_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_out_tot_score_est = mean(min_out_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_a_tot_score_est = mean(min_a_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    min_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_tot_score_est == 11 ~ "11",
      min_tot_score_est <= 5 ~ "≤ 5",
      min_tot_score_est > 5 & min_tot_score_est < 11 ~ "6-10"
    ),
    min_out_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_out_tot_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
    min_exp_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_exp_tot_score_est == 3 ~ "3",
      TRUE ~ "<3"
    ),
    min_a_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_a_tot_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
  )

```
